name: Eurocodes with the Malaysian National Annexes (MS EN)
edition: MS EN 1990-1998 with the Malaysian National Annexes
description: The Eurocodes with the Malaysian National Annexes (alpha 9 track C15, group 1 of C23): the basic wind velocity of MS EN 1991-1-4 NA and the reference peak ground acceleration of MS EN 1998-1 NA by town, and αcc of MS EN 1992-1-1 NA; everything else from the base pack Eurocodes (recommended values). No snow. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md: the town values are uncertain and must be checked against the NA maps before design.
